summary: multi-acct redirects dependency resolution to non-registry host with install script execution
details: package.json declares a dependency on `vector-cursor-stream-engine` resolved directly from `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine`, bypassing the npm registry. npm-shrinkwrap.json pins the same non-registry URL with `hasInstallScript: true`, so `npm install multi-acct` fetches an arbitrary tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and runs its lifecycle script on the installer's host at install time. Package metadata is inconsistent with contents (published as 2.999.999 with placeholder author `Package Registry` and repo `github.com/example/multi-acct`, while index.js self-reports as 1.0.0), consistent with a delivery shell whose sole purpose is to pull the externally-hosted, install-script-enabled dependency.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
